signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, a suite of AI capabilities embedded in its GRC platform powered by Anthropic's Claude models

email.body1:
Thomas, saw Onspring launched Onspring AI, embedding Claude-powered capabilities across your GRC platform.

A launch like that usually creates more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps can work them, and that is exactly where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Thomas, quick follow-up for Onspring.

With new AI capabilities in market, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Thomas, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to peer GRC-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Thomas, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Bringing new AI capabilities to market takes real focus, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
